title: Bahir Dar Lakeside Feast
localName: ባህር ዳር ምግብ — Bahir Dar Mgib
community: Bahir Dar — capital of Amhara region, on Lake Tana
author: Chef Haile
desc: Bahir Dar Lakeside Feast — the feast of Lake Tana's capital city: Lake Tana Fish (ETH087), Asa Wat (ETH081), Fried Nile Perch (ETH082), Amhara Tibs (ETH231), Injera, and the first cup from the Ethiopian coffee ceremony. The feast that defines life on the banks of the Blue Nile source.
longDesc: Bahir Dar on Lake Tana is one of Ethiopia's great food cities — the lakeside restaurants, the fish markets, and the Blue Nile waterfalls nearby create a food experience unique to this city.
steps: Grill Lake Tana fish over charcoal.
chefTips: Fresh Lake Tana fish is the centrepiece — everything else supports it.
commonMistakes: Old fish — freshness is the entire point.
sustainabilityTips: Lake Tana freshwater fish — sustainable when sourced from local fishermen.
servedWith: At a table overlooking Lake Tana
healthBenefits: Very high omega-3 from lake fish.
culturalNote: Bahir Dar lakeside dining is one of Ethiopia's greatest food experiences — the view of Lake Tana with its ancient island monasteries, the fresh fish from the lake, and the Ethiopian coffee ceremony completing the meal. It is a complete sensory and cultural experience.
